Telephone Terminals Functions

Monitoring and Controlling Telephone Terminals

The Telephone Manager provides functions that you can use to monitor and control the physical components of a terminal, such as its hookswitch, speaker, display, or microphone.
Note
Some telephone terminals might not support all of these functions.
